name: Typing article

title_i18n.ja: タイピング練習用の文章

description: Original level-targeted prose for typing practice.

description_i18n.en: Original level-targeted prose for typing practice.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 生成符合目标难度的原创文章，供打字练习使用。
description_i18n.ja: 目標の難易度に合わせた、タイピング練習用のオリジナル文章を作成します。

name: English companion
description: Natural conversation with optional gentle corrections.

description_i18n.en: Natural conversation with optional gentle corrections.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 自然英语会话，可选择温和纠错。
description_i18n.ja: 自然な英会話。希望に応じて穏やかに間違いを訂正します。

description_i18n.zh-CN: 全程只用英语进行简洁对话。
description_i18n.ja: 英語だけで簡潔に会話します。

name: Prepositions in Pictures

title_i18n.ja: 絵で学ぶ位置の前置詞

description: Compare six spatial prepositions with paired English and Chinese labels.

variables.name: object
variables.description: One small concrete object used in every panel.

variables.name: reference
variables.default: a blue box with a flat lid
variables.description: A box-like container with a lid, suitable for all six spatial relationships.

description_i18n.en: Compare six spatial prepositions with paired English and Chinese labels.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用中英文标签对照学习六个常见方位介词。
description_i18n.ja: 6つの位置の前置詞を英語と中国語のラベルで比較します。

name: Everyday Scene Vocabulary

title_i18n.ja: 日常シーンの語彙イラスト

description: Explore a scene through bilingual object labels and a short example sentence.

variables.name: scene
variables.description: A simple fictional everyday setting.

variables.name: labels
variables.default: choose three or four everyday objects that fit the requested scene
variables.description: Optional object names, or an instruction to choose objects appropriate to the scene.

description_i18n.en: Explore a scene through bilingual object labels and a short example sentence.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 在生活场景中学习中英物品名称，附一组双语例句。
description_i18n.ja: 日常の場面で英語と中国語の物の名前と短い対訳文を学びます。

name: Four-panel Story Prompts
description: Create a four-panel story with a short English sentence and Chinese translation in every panel.

variables.name: story
variables.default: A person plants a seed, waters it, sees a sprout, and later picks a flower.
variables.description: A fictional four-step sequence with a clear beginning and end.

description_i18n.en: Create a four-panel story with a short English sentence and Chinese translation in every panel.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 生成四格故事，每格附一句简短英文和对应中文翻译。
description_i18n.ja: 各コマに短い英文と中国語訳を添えた4コマの物語を作ります。

name: Illustrated Vocabulary Card
description: Create a bilingual illustrated word card with a short example sentence.

variables.name: word
variables.description: One English word to render exactly.

variables.name: meaning
variables.default: infer the most relevant concrete meaning from the target word or subject
variables.description: A specific sense if needed; otherwise infer it from the target.

variables.name: style
variables.description: A general visual style, not a named artist.

variables.name: label_layout
variables.description: word for a whole-word label, or letter-tiles for one letter per tile; short words of three to six lowercase letters work best for tiles.

description_i18n.en: Create a bilingual illustrated word card with a short example sentence.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 生成中英文单词卡，配一条与画面对应的双语例句。
description_i18n.ja: 英語と中国語の単語カードに、絵に合う短い対訳例文を添えます。

name: Collocation Lab

title_i18n.ja: 自然な語の組み合わせ練習

description: Learn natural word partners through contextual choices and short rewrites.

variables.name: word
variables.description: One English word or short phrase.

variables.name: level
variables.description: Target CEFR writing difficulty, not a proficiency assessment.

variables.name: feedback_language
variables.description: Language for brief explanations; practice answers remain in English.

description_i18n.en: Learn natural word partners through contextual choices and short rewrites.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过语境选择和简短改写，练习自然的词语搭配。
description_i18n.ja: 文脈に合う表現の選択と短い書き換えで、自然な語の組み合わせを練習します。

name: Everyday Email Practice

title_i18n.ja: 日常の英文メール練習

description: Draft a fictional practical email and revise its clarity, tone, and wording.

variables.name: situation
variables.default: asking a classmate to reschedule a study session
variables.description: A fictional low-stakes writing scenario.

variables.name: level
variables.description: Target CEFR writing difficulty, not a proficiency assessment.

variables.name: feedback_language
variables.description: Language for brief explanations; practice answers remain in English.

description_i18n.en: Draft a fictional practical email and revise its clarity, tone, and wording.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 练习撰写虚构场景的实用邮件，改进表达清晰度、语气和措辞。
description_i18n.ja: 架空の実用的なメールを書き、明確さ、語調、言葉遣いを改善します。

name: Everyday Role-play

title_i18n.ja: 日常場面のロールプレイ

description: Rehearse a practical situation through realistic turns and a short recap.

variables.name: scenario
variables.default: ordering a snack at a cafe
variables.description: A fictional everyday situation.

variables.name: level
variables.description: Target CEFR writing difficulty, not a proficiency assessment.

variables.name: feedback_language
variables.description: Language for brief explanations; practice answers remain in English.

description_i18n.en: Rehearse a practical situation through realistic turns and a short recap.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过真实感的轮流对话练习实用场景，结束后简短回顾。
description_i18n.ja: 実用的な場面を自然なやり取りで練習し、最後に短く振り返ります。

name: Grammar Repair Workshop
description: Correct one grammar point at a time with explanations and a fresh retry.

variables.name: grammar
variables.description: One grammar point.

variables.name: level
variables.description: Target CEFR writing difficulty, not a proficiency assessment.

variables.name: feedback_language
variables.description: Language for brief explanations; practice answers remain in English.

description_i18n.en: Correct one grammar point at a time with explanations and a fresh retry.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 每次纠正一个语法要点，结合解释和新题重练。
description_i18n.ja: 一度に一つの文法事項を直し、説明を確認して新しい文で再練習します。

name: Read, Recall, Explain

title_i18n.ja: 読んで、思い出して、説明する

description: Read a short original passage and discuss comprehension without answer spoilers.

variables.name: topic
variables.description: A non-sensitive topic for original practice material.

variables.name: level
variables.description: Target CEFR writing difficulty, not a proficiency assessment.

variables.name: feedback_language
variables.description: Language for brief explanations; practice answers remain in English.

description_i18n.en: Read a short original passage and discuss comprehension without answer spoilers.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 阅读原创短文，通过问答检查理解，不提前泄露答案。
description_i18n.ja: オリジナルの短文を読み、答えを先に見ずに読解のやり取りをします。

name: Summarize and Paraphrase

title_i18n.ja: 要約とパラフレーズ練習

description: Practice concise, accurate summaries while preserving meaning and uncertainty.

variables.name: topic
variables.default: why small habits can be easier to maintain
variables.description: A non-sensitive topic for original practice material.

variables.name: level
variables.description: Target CEFR writing difficulty, not a proficiency assessment.

variables.name: feedback_language
variables.description: Language for brief explanations; practice answers remain in English.

description_i18n.en: Practice concise, accurate summaries while preserving meaning and uncertainty.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 练习简洁准确的摘要，保留原意和不确定程度。
description_i18n.ja: 元の意味と不確かさを保ちながら、簡潔で正確な要約を練習します。

name: Vocabulary Recall Coach
description: Practice meaning-to-word recall, contextual use, and retrying missed words.

variables.name: words
variables.description: Three to eight English words to practice.

variables.name: level
variables.description: Target CEFR writing difficulty, not a proficiency assessment.

variables.name: feedback_language
variables.description: Language for brief explanations; practice answers remain in English.

description_i18n.en: Practice meaning-to-word recall, contextual use, and retrying missed words.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 根据词义回忆单词、在语境中使用，并重试答错的单词。
description_i18n.ja: 意味から単語を思い出し、文脈の中で使い、間違えた単語を再練習します。

name: Children's Storybook Builder

title_i18n.ja: 子ども向け英語絵本づくり

description: Write a bilingual storybook manuscript with per-page image prompts and a clean English reading copy.

variables.name: age_range
variables.description: Broad audience age range, not a child's birth date or personal details.

variables.name: level
variables.description: Target English difficulty: A1, A2, or B1; independent of age and not an assessment.

variables.name: theme
variables.default: asking for help and working together
variables.description: A gentle fictional theme or small everyday problem.

variables.name: page_count
variables.description: Whole number of story pages from 4 to 12; excludes the title and production notes.

variables.name: target_words
variables.description: Three to five useful everyday English words to repeat naturally.

variables.name: illustration_style
variables.default: simple watercolor with soft colors and clear shapes
variables.description: A broad visual style, without a named artist or copyrighted franchise.

description_i18n.en: Write a bilingual storybook manuscript with per-page image prompts and a clean English reading copy.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 创作中英双语绘本文稿，附每页生图提示词和纯英文阅读副本。
description_i18n.ja: 英語と中国語の絵本原稿に、各ページの画像生成指示と英語だけの読書用本文を添えます。

name: Choose Your Story

title_i18n.ja: 選んでつづける英語ストーリー

description: Co-create a child-safe story through typed decisions that change the plot, then collect the chosen path into a clean reading copy.

variables.name: age_range
variables.description: Broad audience age range, without identifying a real child.

variables.name: level
variables.description: Target English difficulty: A1, A2, or B1; not a proficiency assessment.

variables.name: theme
variables.default: forest friends preparing a small picnic
variables.description: A gentle fictional story theme with low-stakes choices.

variables.name: scene_count
variables.description: Whole number from 3 to 6, counting the opening and final scene of the chosen path.

variables.name: feedback_language
variables.description: Language for requested help or feedback; story prose and choices stay in English.

description_i18n.en: Co-create a child-safe story through typed decisions that change the plot, then collect the chosen path into a clean reading copy.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 通过输入决定共同创作适合儿童的故事，选择会改变情节，最后可整理所选路线的纯阅读副本。
description_i18n.ja: 入力した選択で筋書きが変わる、子ども向けの安全な物語を一緒に作り、選んだ展開を読み物用の本文にまとめます。

name: Bilingual Storybook Page

title_i18n.ja: 英語・中国語の絵本ページ

description: Draw one children’s storybook page with short English text and its Chinese translation.

variables.name: story
variables.default: A little rabbit finds a blue mitten and returns it to a friend.
variables.description: A gentle fictional event for one illustrated page.

variables.name: style
variables.description: A general visual style without a named artist.

description_i18n.en: Draw one children’s storybook page with short English text and its Chinese translation.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 生成一张儿童绘本页，附简短英文故事和中文翻译。
description_i18n.ja: 短い英文と中国語訳を添えた子ども向け絵本の1ページを描きます。
